🧹 **F-STO-1 (attended 2026-10-25; the owner: "Can you help clean up the storage needed by Gold Rush … I think Gold Rush uses 600 GB") — THE DISK HELD 1,312 GB OF GOLD RUSH, 86 GB FREE OF 3.6 TB; EVERY SCRATCH WORKTREE CARRIES THE 9–11 GB TRACKED `artifacts/` TREE, SO CHECKOUTS WERE THE MULTIPLIER. Group A (regenerable scratch, no history) removed on the owner's "clean A": 30 merged sibling worktrees `~/Claude/Projects/wt-*` (~300 GB), 21 fire/attended arena checkouts under `~/.goldrush/` (their logs kept), the `land/wt-preview-pub` rsync staging copy (86 GB), four re-land clones in `~/.goldrush/repair` whose tips equal the `candidate/*` branches on GitHub (53 GB; commit maps kept), two old gate worktrees in the primary, eight orphan lane copies inside the history clone whose `.git` files pointed at the primary's live lanes (their 94 untracked unique files, 354 MB of July marketing reels and raw media, archived first to `~/.goldrush/archive/history-local-worktrees-untracked-2026-10-25/`), the stray `Gold%20Rush` folder. Every removal through `git worktree remove` after a merged-branch check and an evidence-only dirt check; 14 items the checks held back were examined by hand (stale checkouts: files equal to blobs of 2026-09-20 / 2026-07-05 commits; a gate worktree whose edits equal main's; control arenas differing only in the pilots symlink) and removed in a second pass. Result: free 86 GB → 782 GB. KEPT AS HISTORY: the history clone's `.git` (106 GB, the only full copy of the private history archive: 443 of its 613 refs are not on GitHub), the film's 23 takes (24 GB), `GoldRush-assets` (13 GB), the primary's `artifacts/`, `logs/`, `tasks/runs` (17 GB), `gr-worktree-evidence`, the run logs.
